concepts.prompt: Create one original isolated 2D painted sprite for the existing mobile match-3 game Royal Magic. Match the art direction of the user's last attached examples, which are visual material and silhouette references only: compact spherical icons, vividly contrasted painted colors, bright golden yellow and orange edges, deep saturated blue or plum shadows, large simple shapes, hand-placed soft glints. The chunky readable forms, directed contrast and painterly volume matter more than realistic light. It should feel like a professional custom 2D game icon hand-painted in Photoshop, with deliberate crisp color boundaries, rich colored contact shadows in the seams, bold restrained highlights, and a clean silhouette at 34 pixels wide. Draw with soft blended shading inside solid shapes, clear contour and balanced color grouping. View from slightly above, keep a nearly spherical silhouette. Deliver only a single sprite centered on a square truly transparent canvas with 12% generous margin, no UI, no floor, no halo outside the sprite, no text, no numbers, no logo, no other objects. This is 2D painted game art: no photographed materials, no polygon facets, no 3D-render look or PBR reflections, no grain, no busy intricate details, no extraneous sparkles or lens flare. Design an original object, do not recreate any of the attached game icons or reuse their symbols. Design A, Orbe do Caos. A cheerful enchanted puzzle sphere, made from a few big curved ceramic shell panels that meet cleanly and hug a single continuous round body. Organize the color panels into two rows plus a small top cap using flowing longitude seams. Exactly four prominent broad color segments visible on each row at most. Contrasting deep plum hairline seams sit recessed at real intersections. The largest visible colors are warm yellow, vermilion red, azure blue, bright leaf green and purple. A single warm-gold equatorial collar curves smoothly around the shell. At the center front the collar swells into a small painted gold mount containing a four-point recessed cream magical compass star, no lightning symbol. Make the upper row show warm red at left, broad sunny yellow near center, fresh mint/leaf green at right; the lower row shows violet merging visually with a bold blue and teal cell. Clean integrated shell material, wide readable colors rather than separate square buttons, perspective where the outer panels curve away around the sphere. One broad upper-left golden highlight, edge contours in dark colored shadows. Simple and energetic, visibly a multicolor collectible special.
